# Lightmorphic Text

A graphical front end for Espanso, the text expander, for Linux. Browse,
search, add and edit text expansions without opening a YAML file. Free and
open source (GPL-3.0-or-later), shipped as a single AppImage by
Lightmorphic Ltd (UK company 17423646).

- Website: https://text.lightmorphic.com/
- Guide: https://text.lightmorphic.com/help.html
- Source: https://text.buildmorphic.com/code
- Download: https://text.buildmorphic.com/download/latest/LightmorphicText-x86_64.AppImage
